title: French Flanders display revision
method: Removed the atlas Dutch/Flemish solid footprint only inside the Natural Earth France boundary. The existing French reference background is visible there. A French Flemish peerd point at Quaëdypre preserves minority-language presence without inventing a modern majority-speaking boundary. Dutch/Flemish areas outside France are unchanged. This is an editorial display choice, not a new census or an assertion that Flemish has disappeared.

sources.title: CNRS MoDyCo, Entrelangues: West Flemish, minority use and French dominance
French Ministry of Culture: regional languages, including West Flemish
ANVT–ILRF: French Flemish peerd in local usage (Quaëdypre)

geometrySources: Natural Earth country boundary, public domain
countCaveat: Older speaker estimates reported by Entrelangues are not treated as a current count or used to calculate a speaker-area polygon.
